iterations: Model01 passes independent geometry after correcting a copied validator OBJ path. Model02 uses the generated denser coverts-v2 atlas, shorter swept tufts with brow volumes and a smaller Kakuy beak; independent anatomy and all23 quantized pose checks pass. Final previews pass51 assertions each. Model03/04 refresh contact-status provenance; only manifest.json changes from model02, all15 art/container files remain identical. Six initial/final previews, prior design/contact/animation data and first copied-path failure are retained.
